localization_rules: Keep public posts price-free unless a campaign is explicitly approved.
Use local currency only in private proposals or approved campaign pages.
Avoid jargon such as CTA, hero, funnel or conversion rate unless explained in plain language.
Do not claim guaranteed results, best-in-the-world status or unverifiable client outcomes.
Mention apps explicitly when the service list appears: siti, e-commerce, web app, app, automazioni AI.
For every market, connect the message to a business problem: more trust, clearer requests, better reservation paths, easier payments, or ongoing visibility.
